Resolution 2669 demands an immediate end to violence, calls for humanitarian access, and acknowledges ASEAN's central role. It requests the Secretary-General or his Special Envoy, in coordination with the ASEAN Special Envoy, to report orally to the Security Council by 15 March 2023 on UN support for the Five-Point Consensus.

This fictional scheduling exercise establishes no official decision or commitment. The chair proposes the early briefing slot.

liaison office calendar: both. The UN office's exact calendar was not delivered. Both of its published calendar alternatives allow early.
